requiredFindings.location: PROPOSAL.md:478 (item 13, “What is on the wire”); X10 at PROPOSAL.md:705
requiredFindings.problem: Item 13 says the only identities on the provider wire are executionId, snapshotId, planId and the universe key, and it cites NE:3158-3163 and NE:3166-3189 for that closed set. Those lines put further members on both OpenUniverse payloads. The same law’s item 15 requires HelloAck identity members that are also on the wire. J1 r3 already forbids any identity on a provider wire beyond r1’s copy of this sentence, and X10 says that citation needs no content change.
requiredFindings.evidence: NE:3166-3177 TypeScriptOpenUniverseV2 is {executionId, snapshotId, planId, planIntentCommitment, providerId, universe, universeKey}. NE:3178-3187 OpenUniverseV3 adds repositoryResolution (dependencySourceSetId, preparedOutputSetId, authorizationId, effects) and has no separate universeKey field; the universe coordinate is defined at NE:3161-3163. NE:3159 says executionId and planIntentCommitment keep their owners. HelloAckV3’s five identity members equal expectedIdentity (NE:2830-2833). TypeScriptHelloAckV2 carries providerDescriptorSha256, runtimeDescriptorSha256 and the descriptor identity fields (NE:2973-2981). Item 15 requires those handshake checks. PROPOSAL-r1.md:377 is the same closed sentence. J1:192 forbids “any identity on a provider’s wire beyond M3L:377’s”. RequestId is absent from both OpenUniverse payloads, which supports the RequestId half of item 13.
requiredFindings.fix: Rewrite item 13 so the four names are the correlation identities that cross the wire, and name the protocol members the contracts already require beside them: Hello and HelloAck identity members, planIntentCommitment, providerId, the universe object, and Rust repositoryResolution. Keep the prohibition on RequestId, RunId, ProjectId, a log path, and any identity the two protocols do not already carry. In X10, except J1:192: the next J1 revision re-reads that forbidden substitute against the corrected inventory. r1:377 stays the historical sentence J1 currently cites.

nonBlockingObservations.observation: The delta round records one outcome, (A), (B) or (C). When F is over 2 s and T misses a medium budget, both (B) and (C) apply, and both O3 and O4 arise. The dependence section does not name that joint case. Record every failed comparison. Items 1 and 2 stay one-shot under both.
